title: How Small Can You Go? LoRA Fine-Tuning 270M-8B Models for Merchant Information Extraction in Financial Transactions
abstract: arXiv:2606.08051v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Merchant information extraction turns noisy financial transaction descriptors into structured fields at production scale. Our deployed LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA~3.1-8B reaches 96.95\% F1, but its memory and throughput motivate smaller replacements. We evaluate 23 retained fine-tuning runs plus a separately trained production reference, spanning Gemma~3 (270M--4B), Qwen~3.5 (0.8B--4B), Aya~3.35B, and LLaMA~3.1-8B across LoRA ranks, prompts, training templates, and serving environments. A rank-8 LLaMA fine-tune reaches 96.75\% F1, only 0.20 points below the rank-32 production reference. Qwen~3.5~4B with JSON-Only prompting reaches 96.60\% F1 and strict record-level exact match of 91.67\%, with a $3.8\times$ lower inverse-throughput time estimate than the rank-8 8B model. Qwen~3.5~0.8B reaches 94.75\% F1, and Qwen Think and Nothink templates differ by less than 0.004 F1. Across 14 Databricks endpoints, mean F1 change from local evaluation i

translated_title: 你能做到多小？面向金融交易商户信息提取的270M-8B模型LoRA微调研究
translated_abstract: 商户信息提取在生产规模上将嘈杂的金融交易描述转换为结构化字段。我们部署的LoRA微调LLaMA~3.1-8B模型达到了96.95%的F1分数，但其内存和吞吐量促使我们寻找更小的替代方案。我们评估了23次保留的微调运行以及一个单独训练的生产参考模型，涵盖Gemma~3（270M--4B）、Qwen~3.5（0.8B--4B）、Aya~3.35B和LLaMA~3.1-8B，跨越不同的LoRA秩、提示、训练模板和服务环境。秩为8的LLaMA微调达到了96.75%的F1分数，仅比秩为32的生产参考低0.20个百分点。使用仅JSON提示的Qwen~3.5~4B达到了96.60%的F1分数和91.67%的严格记录级精确匹配，其逆吞吐时间估计比秩为8的8B模型低3.8倍。Qwen~3.5~0.8B达到了94.75%的F1分数，且Qwen Think和Nothink模板之间的差异小于0.004 F1。在14个Databricks端点中，平均F1变化与本地评估相比略有差异。
tldr: 本研究通过系统评估多种小型模型的LoRA微调，发现Qwen~3.5~4B在保持与8B模型相当性能的同时，显著降低资源消耗，实现了高效商户信息提取。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates LoRA fine-tuning across various small models, finding that Qwen~3.5~4B maintains comparable performance to 8B models while significantly reducing resource consumption for efficient merchant information extraction.
